arxiv-1910-00900.description: Abstract In this work 2-(bis(cyanomethyl)amino)-2-oxoethyl methacrylate (CMA2OEM) molecule has been characterized theoretically. First, the potential energy surface has been calculated to find the lowest energy state of the molecule. After the most stable state of the molecule, Mulliken atomic charge and nonlinear-optical properties were investigated.

arxiv-2208-08138.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by . We show that d d -variate polynomials of degree R R can be represented on [ 0 , 1 ] d [0,1]^{d} as shallow neural networks of width 2 ​ ( R + d ) d 2(R+d)^{d} . Also, by SNN representation of localized Taylor polynomials of univariate C β C^{\beta} -smooth functions, we derive for shallow networks the minimax optimal rate of convergence, up to a logarithmic factor, to unknown univariate regression function.

arxiv-2211-14432.title: A1 SLAM: Quadruped SLAM using the A1’s onboard sensors
arxiv-2211-14432.creator: Jerred Chen, Frank Dellaert
arxiv-2211-14432.description: Abstract Quadrupeds are robots that have been of interest in the past few years due to their versatility in navigating across various terrain and utility in several applications. For quadrupeds to navigate without a predefined map a priori, they must rely on SLAM approaches to localize and build the map of the environment.

arxiv-2501-14195.title: VideoShield : Regulating Diffusion-based Video Generation Models via Watermarking
arxiv-2501-14195.creator: Runyi Hu, Jie Zhang, Yiming Li, Jiwei Li, Qing Guo, Han Qiu, Tianwei Zhang
arxiv-2501-14195.description: Abstract Artificial Intelligence Generated Content (AIGC) has advanced significantly, particularly with the development of video generation models such as text-to-video (T2V) models and image-to-video (I2V) models. However, like other AIGC types, video generation requires robust content control. A common approach is to embed watermarks, but most research has focused on images, with limited attention given to videos.

arxiv-2504-16901.title: Characterizing Fragments of Collection in Set Theory by Model-Theoretic Properties
arxiv-2504-16901.creator: Junhong Chen
arxiv-2504-16901.description: Abstract We compare the model theory of the weak set theory 𝖣𝖡 0 \mathsf{DB}_{0} with that of the algebraic theory 𝖯𝖠 − \mathsf{PA}^{-} . Every model of 𝖣𝖡 0 \mathsf{DB}_{0} has a proper taller* end extension with an exact transitive cover, paralleling the corresponding end-extension result for 𝖯𝖠 − \mathsf{PA}^{-} .

arxiv-2509-24787.title: A tree bijection for rigid quadrangulations
arxiv-2509-24787.creator: Bart Zonneveld
arxiv-2509-24787.description: Abstract We study the counting problem of rigid quadrangulations, recently introduced by Budd [ 8 ] and proven to be in bijection with colorful quadrangulations. The generating function for the latter has been derived in an algebraic manner by Bousquet-Mélou and Elvey Price [ 3 ] , which therefore also counts rigid quadrangulations.

arxiv-2511-02018.title: Neural Field Transformations for Hybrid Monte Carlo: Architectural Design and Scaling
arxiv-2511-02018.creator: Jinchen He, Xiao-Yong Jin, James C. Osborn, Yong Zhao
arxiv-2511-02018.description: Abstract Critical slowing down, where autocorrelation grows rapidly near the continuum limit due to Hybrid Monte Carlo (HMC) moving through configuration space inefficiently, still challenges lattice gauge theory simulations. Combining neural field transformations with HMC (NTHMC) can reshape the energy landscape and accelerate sampling, but the choice of neural architectures has yet to be studied systematically.

pmc-12656401.title: Influenza Vaccination and Morbidity Among Sudanese Hajj Pilgrims During the 2025 Hajj
pmc-12656401.creator: Najim Z. Alshahrani, Mohammed R. Algethami, Abdulrahman M. Albeshry, Zuhier Awan, Wael AlZhrani, Osama A. Bugis, Abdullah Jaber Alsahafi, Harunor Rashid
pmc-12656401.description: Background: Little is known about morbidity patterns and healthcare utilization among specific Hajj pilgrim groups. This study examined influenza vaccination coverage, disease spectrum and healthcare utilization outcomes among Sudanese pilgrims during Hajj 2025. Methods: A cross-sectional analysis was conducted using de-identified patient records from the Saudi Health Electronic Surveillance Network for Sudanese Hajj pilgrims in 1–9 June 2025.

pmc-13095313.title: Nonlinear associations of oxidative balance score with central and peripheral thyroid hormone sensitivity: A cross-sectional study of NHANES 2007 to 2012
pmc-13095313.creator: Zhu-Zhu Wang, Yu-Han Zhang, Qin Xu, Ji Zhou, Yong-Xia Song, Yi Wang, Xiao-Qing Lv, Jing-Fang Hong
pmc-13095313.description: Oxidative balance score (OBS) integrates dietary/lifestyle factors to assess cumulative oxidative stress, yet its association with thyroid hormone sensitivity remains unexplored. This study aimed to investigate the relationship between OBS and thyroid hormone sensitivity through central and peripheral regulation mechanisms. This cross-sectional study analyzed data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (2007–2012), involving 5536 participants.

pmc-13326336.title: A nomogram integrating dynamic total bile acid monitoring, medication history, and curative effect for preterm birth prediction in twin pregnancies with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy
pmc-13326336.creator: Fei Ding, Jia Li, Minjie Zhang, Yanhua Zhao, Shanshan Liang, Qianwen Zhang
pmc-13326336.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveIntrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP) complicated by twin pregnancy significantly increases the risk of preterm birth, and no tailored predictive tools for gestational age (GA) at delivery have been developed for this specific population to date. This study aimed to develop and validate a twin-specific nomogram with dynamic total bile acid (TBA) monitoring, medication history and curative effect for preterm birth prediction in this population.MethodsA retrospective cohort of 258 twin pregnancies complicated by ICP was enrolled (November 2024–November 2025).

pmc-13377015.title: TeO2-modified SiO2-B2O3-Al2O3 glasses with enhanced dielectric constant and dissipation factor for advanced semiconductor packaging applications
pmc-13377015.creator: Linganna Kadathala, Yong-Tak Ryu, Young-Ouk Park, Won-Taek Han, Bok Hyeon Kim
pmc-13377015.description: Recently, glass has emerged as a core substrate material for next-generation semiconductor packaging applications compared with organic substrates because of its low dielectric property, low coefficients of thermal expansion, and excellent scalability. In this study, we present new TeO2-modified alkaline-earth alumino-borosilicate glasses with enhanced dielectric and thermomechanical properties for advanced packaging applications.

pmc-13390269.title: Social determinants of intersectional inequalities in multimorbidity and its burden in China: a multilevel analysis of individual heterogeneity and discriminatory accuracy (MAIHDA)
pmc-13390269.creator: Zhili Chen, Yaoda Hu, Huijing He, Qiong Ou, Yawen Liu, Tan Xu, Ji Tu, Zhiming Lu, Zichao Wang, Da Xu, Qing Wang, Zhujie Ran, Mengwei Zhang, Guangliang Shan
pmc-13390269.description: BackgroundConventional epidemiological studies often rely on average associations for single social determinants, which may obscure heterogeneity across jointly defined social positions. This study applied an intersectionality-informed Multilevel Analysis of Individual Heterogeneity and Discriminatory Accuracy (MAIHDA) approach to examine disparities in multimorbidity prevalence and burden among Chinese adults.MethodsWe analyzed 25,409 participants from the 2023–2024 China National Health Survey.

pmc-13410127.title: Plectin 1d Isoform as a Potential Regulator of Metastatic Progression in Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma
pmc-13410127.creator: Hulya Gundesli, Betul Budak, Kazim Yalcin Arga
pmc-13410127.description: Papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC) typically exhibits a favorable prognosis; however, lymph node and distant metastases continue to present significant clinical challenges. Plectin isoform 1d (PLEC 1d) contributes to myofiber integrity and is implicated in cytoskeletal organization and cancer cell motility, but its role in PTC progression is largely unknown.

pmc-13523834.title: The effectiveness of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) on binge eating in patients with obesity: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13523834.creator: Isobel Emptage, Stella Kozmér, Antemeka Cobham-Wilson, Bernardo Sousa, Kirsty Sugden, Lauren Wheeler, Clare Llewellyn, Janine Makaronidis, Cynthia Bulik, Francesca Solmi, Ilaria Costantini
pmc-13523834.description: SummaryBackgroundGlucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs), widely used for weight management and type 2 diabetes, may reduce binge eating behaviours and body dissatisfaction, but there are concerns that they might increase eating restraint. We evaluated the effectiveness of GLP-1RAs for binge eating severity and related eating behaviours.

pmc-13542523.title: Peritoneal effusion as a marker of disease severity in secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis: Clinical and immunological insights
pmc-13542523.creator: Yansheng Wang, Lulu Zhang, Huiping Wang, Qian Li, Furun An, Beibei Xie, Shuangwei Ying, Jinxiao Hou, Hui Qin, Zhimin Zhai, Fan Wu
pmc-13542523.description: ObjectiveHemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) is a life-threatening hyperinflammatory syndrome with cytokine storm-mediated multiorgan damage. Although serous effusions are frequent complications, the prognostic significance of peritoneal effusion in secondary HLH (sHLH) remains undefined. This study aimed to determine the incidence, clinical and immunological correlates, and prognostic value of peritoneal effusion in sHLH patients.

pmc-13574557.title: Evaluation of the Correlation of Calprotectin and SES-CD Score at the Time of Diagnosis and Follow-up After Diagnosis in Pediatric Patients With Crohn’s Disease in Korea
pmc-13574557.creator: Yiyoung Kwon, Seo Hee Kim, Yoo Min Lee, Eun Sil Kim, Eun Hye Lee, Sujin Choi, Byung-Ho Choe, Hyo-Jeong Jang, In Sook Jeong, Juyoung Kim, Dae Yong Yi, Soon Chul Kim, Yeoun Joo Lee, So Yoon Choi, Yoon Lee, Yon Ho Choe, Ben Kang
pmc-13574557.description: BackgroundCrohn’s disease (CD) requires reliable tools for monitoring intestinal inflammation. Fecal calprotectin (FC) has emerged as a promising non-invasive biomarker. This study aimed to evaluate the correlation between FC and endoscopic activity in pediatric CD confined to the colon and to establish FC cutoff values corresponding to disease severity and remission.

pmc-13657533.title: When promotion becomes a bounty on publications: how academic reward systems shape publication behavior, with lessons from Nepal
pmc-13657533.creator: Naveen Gautam
pmc-13657533.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The criteria institutions use to appoint and promote academics shape how science is produced. Where advancement is tied tightly to publication counts, researchers respond rationally to the incentive, and publication behavior shifts toward volume. This article uses the faculty-promotion regulations of Tribhuvan University, Nepal’s largest higher education institution, as a worked example of how publication-weighted criteria may reward output over scientific merit.

uslaw-usc-t33-s2314a.title: 33 U.S.C. § 2314a — Technical assistance program
uslaw-usc-t33-s2314a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t33-s2314a.description: United States Code, Title 33 (Navigation And Navigable Waters); Chapter 36 (Water Resources Development); Subchapter V (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In general The Secretary is authorized to provide technical assistance, on a nonexclusive basis, to any United States firm which is competing for, or has been awarded, a contract for the planning, design, or construction of a project.

uslaw-usc-t42-s11005.title: 42 U.S.C. § 11005 — Emergency training and review of emergency systems
uslaw-usc-t42-s11005.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s11005.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 116 (Emergency Planning And Community Right-To-Know); Subchapter I (Emergency Planning And Notification). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Emergency training (1) Programs Officials of the United States Government carrying out existing Federal programs for emergency training are authorized to specifically provide training and education programs for Federal, State, and local personnel.
